# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 years old at the end of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P58](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0058)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c38 P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)</sub>
- **Titles:** Winner of the Avery Scholarship  <sub>[v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is thin and skinny, with a pointed, freckled face, large gray eyes, and a neat, pretty nose. Her hair is naturally a bright red, which she briefly dyed a dull bronzy green before having it shingled short. As she matures, she grows tall, eventually surpassing Marilla in height.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P17](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0017), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, passionate, and impulsive girl who experiences emotions with extreme intensity. She possesses a intense love for beautiful things and romantic names, though her quick temper and fierce pride can cause explosive reactions when her appearance is mocked. She holds a strong capacity for devotion and loyalty to her friends, while also maintaining an unyielding tenacity when holding grudges. Despite her dramatic tendencies and habit of making unusual mistakes, she proves to be hardworking, intensely competitive, and deeply dutiful.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P17](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0017), [v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c10 P45](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0045), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c15 P94](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0094), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c21 P56](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0056), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c38 P8](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0008)_

## History

Anne Shirley was mistakenly sent to Green Gables to live with Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, who had requested a boy from the asylum. Upon arriving in Avonlea at eleven years old, she quickly formed a passionate friendship with Diana Barry and developed a fierce rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he called her 'Carrots' in class. Her dramatic antics led to various scrapes, including accidentally getting green hair from a peddler's dye and falling off a roof on a dare. Despite her impulsiveness, she saved Diana's sister Minnie May during a bout of croup, earning Mrs. Barry's complete forgiveness. Under the mentorship of Miss Stacy, she joined the Queen's class, tied with Gilbert for top entry marks, and ultimately won the prestigious Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy. Following Matthew's sudden death and the threat of Marilla losing her eyesight, Anne chose to give up her college scholarship, stay at Green Gables to care for Marilla, and take up teaching at the local Avonlea school while finally reconciling her long-standing feud with Gilbert Blythe.

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia to high school teacher Walter Shirley and Bertha Shirley  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Lived in an asylum and cared for twins prior to coming to Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c6 P25](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0025), [v1 c7 P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002), [v1 c7 P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012)</sub>

## Quotes
